original_sentence: Society tends to celebrate personal achievement and commend it based on the assumption that winning or succeeding is a consequence of working harder than the next person.
translation: 社会倾向于赞美个人成就，并基于这样一种假设来称颂它：获胜或成功是比别人更努力的结果。

key_vocabulary.usage_note: based on the assumption that 在本句中对应"基于……的假设"。
a consequence of 在本句中对应"……的结果"。
work harder than 在本句中对应"比……更努力"。
tend to 在本句中对应"倾向于"。
personal achievement 在本句中对应"个人成就"。
